    14% MORE and scored the same, because it fell back to grep 8-9 times per run. The index

its neighbours. It is not yet a general win, and a question about how one NAME is spelled
differently for different consumers is a case where it currently is not. Reading source after
the index has named the file is the intended fallback, not a failure.
